spacetime_coverage.subject: Albert Einstein
spacetime_coverage.description: Documented birth, education, research bases, academic visits, international lecture tours, political advocacy and dated public events. Different Berlin and Zurich periods are separated; travel and seasonal appointments are not interpreted as continuous occupancy. Eclipse observing sites in Brazil and Principe, the work of Bose in Dacca, the 1939 White House, and later awards or posthumous debates are NOT mapped as Einstein travel. Modern-country labels are aggregation conveniences; Jerusalem has disputed contemporary status and is not assigned to an exclusive sovereignty category.

description: Reconstructs Albert Einstein’s research from light quanta, Brownian motion and special relativity to general relativity, cosmology and quantum statistics. Connects theoretical developments and observational tests to collaborations, quantum-completeness debates, exile, civil-rights advocacy and efforts toward a unified field theory.
